description.value: Their There is a breakfast and lunch café in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood on West 4th Avenue, opened in 2018 by the team behind the Michelin Star-awarded AnnaLena restaurant. It offers a full-service brunch alongside a grab-and-go program of freshly made mochi donuts, coffee sourced from small independent roasters, and sandwiches. The combination of dine-in and takeout options makes it a practical and distinctive mid-morning or midday stop on a busy urban cycling corridor.
